newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDESPar to sell 10.31 pct stake in Coelba.
newsitem.headline: BNDESPar to sell 10.31 pct stake in Coelba.

text.p: Brazil's BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar), the investment wing of the National Development Bank (BNDES), said it will auction today a 10.31 percent voting stake in Bahia state power utility Coelba.

A total of 1.0 billion common shares will be sold for a minimum price of 66.35 reais per lot of 1,000 shares at an auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange (BVRJ) this afternoon, a BNDESPar official said.

Last year BNDESPar acquired convertible debentures issued by Coelba and committed itself to converting the debentures and selling the shares in stages following the firm's privatization schedule, she said.
BNDESPar sold the first lot of 550 million shares in November last year when Coelba published documents to start a bidding process to hire advisors on the company's selloff.
The second lot of shares will now be sold as winning consultants will be awarded the contracts.
"Our objective is to help accelerating Coelba's privatization and increase the stock's liquidity," she said.
Fifteen financial institutions have guaranteed they would buy Coelba's shares at the auction, the official added.
